title: GitHub Repository Setup
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting github repository setup to GitHub Pages file tree with accessibility, privacy, and publishing checks, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Predict whether a given repository name publishes at the root user-site URL (username.github.io) or at a /repo subpath
Explain why a committed credential must be rotated, not just deleted, and how .gitignore prevents the exposure in the first place
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
